description: Header file for tensor and numpy array conversions and utilities within the torch::utils namespace, defining functions for converting between tensors and numpy arrays, checking numpy availability, and handling numpy data types.

methods.name: tensor_to_numpy
methods.description: Converts a torch tensor to a numpy array, with an optional force parameter.

methods.name: tensor_from_numpy
methods.description: Converts a numpy array (PyObject*) to a torch tensor, with optional warning if not writable.

methods.name: aten_to_numpy_dtype
methods.description: Converts an aten ScalarType to a numpy dtype integer.

methods.name: numpy_dtype_to_aten
methods.description: Converts a numpy dtype integer to an aten ScalarType.

methods.name: is_numpy_available
methods.description: Checks if numpy is available in the environment.

methods.name: is_numpy_int
methods.description: Checks if the PyObject* is a numpy integer.

methods.name: is_numpy_bool
methods.description: Checks if the PyObject* is a numpy boolean.

methods.name: is_numpy_scalar
methods.description: Checks if the PyObject* is a numpy scalar.

methods.name: warn_numpy_not_writeable
methods.description: Issues a warning if the numpy array is not writeable.

methods.name: tensor_from_cuda_array_interface
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a CUDA array interface object, with optional device specification.

methods.name: validate_numpy_for_dlpack_deleter_bug
methods.description: Performs validation related to a known numpy DLPack deleter bug.

methods.name: is_numpy_dlpack_deleter_bugged
methods.description: Checks if the numpy DLPack deleter bug is present.
